source_path: Floom original. Written on 2026-10-10 and first run on Federico De Ponte's own X posts (@fedepontehq, all 267 posts from 2 Sep to 9 Oct 2026, pulled with the X API v2 on 2026-10-09).
note: The method is Federico De Ponte's: split your own posts by kind, links, length, time of day, media and the names you mention, compare medians with their n, then turn only what holds up into a 10-step plan and the next 7 posts in your voice. The scripts were written by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code. x_growth_report.py reads X API v2 JSON, the X data archive or a CSV, runs on the user's computer and makes no network call. fetch_x_posts.py is optional and calls only two read endpoints of api.x.com with the user's own bearer token from the environment. The worked example quotes numbers from that one run; the bundle contains no post data files and no private paths. It is not derived from an upstream skill and is not affiliated with or endorsed by X Corp.
